claim_ceiling: Synthetic NATS JetStream adapter-contract corpus. The Rust reference has not connected to a NATS server or exercised a real JetStream client, consumer, PubAck, AckSync, redelivery, failover or downstream effect owner.
core_rule: JetStream publication, stream metadata, delivery count, redelivery and consumer ACK are transport evidence only. A protected effect is authorized and deduplicated by the current worker claim, owner fence and durable effect-owner receipt.

scenarios.description: Exact account, stream, subject, Nats-Msg-Id and payload binding matches a delivery; it is eligible only for owner revalidation.
Account or NATS domain is substituted while the message ID and payload digest remain unchanged.
Stream name or subject is substituted to a privileged destination.
Application Nats-Msg-Id differs from the bound publication identity.
Payload digest differs from the exact command envelope.
The same Nats-Msg-Id is published inside the configured duplicate window and JetStream returns its broker deduplication PubAck.
The duplicate window expires and the same logical operation is republished with a new Nats-Msg-Id.
An explicit-ACK consumer redelivers the same stream message after AckWait; delivery count increments but the owner claim epoch remains independent.
A delayed worker resumes after a newer durable worker claim epoch is installed.
AckSync receives broker confirmation after a durable effect receipt has already been returned.
AckSync confirmation is presented as proof that a downstream external effect committed.
A PubAck is presented as evidence that a worker executed or a protected effect committed.
The effect owner outcome remains Unknown and no durable reconciliation handoff exists.
An Unknown attempt has a durable exact reconciliation handoff, so the broker message may be acknowledged while recovery remains pending.
The owner returns a terminal durable rejection/quarantine receipt for an invalid or stale command.
The consumer uses AckPolicy All or None where the reference contract requires explicit acknowledgements.
A worker uses InProgress to extend AckWait after its decision or claim validity expired and treats that as renewed authority.
The stream leader fails over and redelivery resolves to one owner-scoped effect receipt despite lost PubAck or consumer ACK responses.

comparator_methods: NATS JetStream broker-native stream persistence, publisher de-duplication, explicit consumer acknowledgement and redelivery
RabbitMQ quorum queues with publisher confirms, manual acknowledgements and at-least-once dead-lettering under matched durability
Apache Kafka transactions for Kafka-managed offsets and output records under matched replication, with external effect owner separately instrumented
Mycelix NATS transport contract plus independently fenced PostgreSQL effect owner and history oracle
evidence_requirements: exact NATS server image/version and async-nats client version
stream, storage, replicas, retention, duplicate window and account configuration
consumer AckPolicy, AckWait, MaxAckPending, MaxDeliver and reconnect configuration
exact command payload, Nats-Msg-Id, stream sequence and consumer delivery traces
worker image, current claim epoch and owner fence evidence
PostgreSQL effect-owner schema, role/grant and commit receipt
raw PubAck, Ack/AckSync response and redelivery traces
exact event bundle and independent history-oracle verdict
10 independent open-loop repetitions and raw latency samples
